page_title: RBL 2-0 MON | RB Leipzig v B. Monchengladbach 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
90+2' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find Stefan Lainer, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
90+1' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
89' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) commits a rough challenge and Soren Storks blows his whistle for a foul. B. Monchengladbach have a free kick.

87' Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) comes close to scoring. He peels away from his marker and gets on the end of a cross from Nathan Ngoumou, but he hits a shot just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
85' A substitution has been made. Rocco Reitz is replaced by Shio Fukuda (B. Monchengladbach).
85' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes just a short run up and his weak free kick from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
85' A dangerous free kick that is situated just outside the box will be taken by Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) who is well-known for his brilliant shooting technique.
83' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) sees a yellow card from Soren Storks after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
82' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) jumps highest to meet an accurate cross and heads the ball towards the net. His fine header whistles just inches wide of the left post.
81' A cross from a corner kick by B. Monchengladbach is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

80' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.

79' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) is very close to scoring! He climbs high to meet a well-taken corner kick and sends it towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper shows good reflexes and stops the header.
78' RB Leipzig fail to score from a corner as Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach) leaps to collect the ball.
78' Here is a change. David Raum is going off and Marco Rose gives the last tactical orders to Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig).
78' The referee allows time for a substitution. Dani Olmo will be replaced by Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
74' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) jumps for a cross and glances a header towards the top left corner, but it's meat and drink for Moritz Nicolas and he comfortably saves.
74' The resulting corner from David Raum (RB Leipzig) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

73' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Moritz Nicolas inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the bottom right corner, but was denied by a great save. RB Leipzig get a corner.

73' RB Leipzig slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
71' David Raum (RB Leipzig) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

71' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) sends a precise pass into the box, but Benjamin Sesko loses the one-on-one with the defender. The ball is out of play. RB Leipzig will have a chance to score from a corner.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Robin Hack departs the field of play to be replaced by Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach).
70' The substitution has been made. Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach) has replaced Ko Itakura.

68' Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
67' Marco Rose decides to make a substitution. Amadou Haidara will be replaced by Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig).
67' A substitution has been made. Yussuf Poulsen goes off and Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) comes on.
67' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
64' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
63' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from David Raum (RB Leipzig). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out. The referee signals a corner kick to RB Leipzig.
63' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from David Raum (RB Leipzig). RB Leipzig will take a corner kick.
59' Gerardo Seoane has decided to substitute Maximilian Wober and he is replaced by Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach).
59' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Joe Scally walks off the pitch to be replaced by Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach).
59' Referee Soren Storks points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) goes wild in celebration.
58' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Soren Storks wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
57' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.

55' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) connects with a cross on the edge of the box, controls the ball and pulls the trigger. Moritz Nicolas makes a beautiful save to deny his effort which would have ended in the top right corner.
50' The resulting set piece from B. Monchengladbach is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

50' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by B. Monchengladbach, is intercepted by one of the defenders. B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
47' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
46' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) has tested the patience of referee Soren Storks and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Dani Olmo, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' What was Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

41' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
40' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
38' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) was too forceful with his tackle and Soren Storks interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
37' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for RB Leipzig.
35' RB Leipzig are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
33' David Raum (RB Leipzig) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
33' Soren Storks shows a yellow card to Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) for his blatant foul.
32' No action against Lois Openda (RB Leipzig), and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Soren Storks got that spot on. VAR seen to good effect there!
31' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Lois Openda (RB Leipzig)! Let's see what he decides.
29' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) is penalised for a foul. Soren Storks had a clear view and blows his whistle.
28' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
27' Soren Storks shows a yellow card to Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) for a tough tackle.
27' The free kick is taken by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach), but ball is cleared. Corner kick. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity.
24' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) receives a nice lofted pass and attempts a quick strike, but it goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
23' Marco Rose is forced to make a change. Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Mohamed Simakan.
20' None of the B. Monchengladbach players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
19' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

18' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Moritz Nicolas. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to RB Leipzig.
18' The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.

14' 1 - 0 Yussuf Poulsen slides a pass towards Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the left side of the goal. The score is now 1:0.
10' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
8' Soren Storks shows a yellow card to Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
8' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) jumps into a tackle and Soren Storks signals a foul. It's a free kick to RB Leipzig, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
7' RB Leipzig seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
5' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul and Soren Storks immediately signals a free kick.
3' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
3' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
1' The match has just started.
RB Leipzig will kick-off.
Soren Storks will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
